dbPath.label: Database path
dbPath.help: Optional override for the agenr knowledge database. Defaults to the dbPath in agenr's config.json, then ~/.agenr/knowledge.db.

configPath.label: Config path
configPath.help: Optional path to agenr's config.json. Defaults to AGENR_CONFIG_PATH, then config.json next to dbPath when dbPath is set, then ~/.agenr/config.json.

episodeModel.label: Episode summary model
episodeModel.help: Optional model override for episode summary generation (provider/model format). Falls back to the agent's primary model when unset.

claimExtractionModel.label: Claim extraction model
claimExtractionModel.help: Model used for claim-key extraction when storing entries. Uses OpenClaw's configured auth. Format: provider/model (for example, openai/gpt-5.4-nano). Defaults to the agent's primary model.

storeNudge.label: Store nudge
storeNudge.help: Optional mid-session reminder settings for prompting durable memory storage after several turns of memory silence.

memoryPolicy.label: Memory policy
memoryPolicy.help: Optional runtime overrides for claim-aware read behavior, session-start memory injection, and proactive before-turn surfacing.

debug.label: Debug log
debug.help: Optional opt-in JSONL debug sink that records recall, session-start, and before-turn decisions into a dedicated agenr log file separate from OpenClaw host logs.

episodeModel.description: Model override for episode summary generation (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'). Falls back to the agent's primary model.

claimExtractionModel.description: Model override for claim-key extraction at store time (e.g. 'openai/gpt-5.4-mini'). Uses OpenClaw auth and falls back to the agent's primary model.

storeNudge.description: Optional mid-session reminder settings for prompting durable memory storage after several turns without memory activity.

enabled.description: Enable or disable mid-session store nudges. Defaults to true.

threshold.description: Turns without durable memory activity before prompting the agent to review recent conversation. Defaults to 8.

maxPerSession.description: Maximum nudges injected during one session lifetime. Defaults to 5.

debug.description: Optional opt-in JSONL debug sink for live OpenClaw runs. Writes agenr-only events to a dedicated log file rather than the shared host log.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the agenr JSONL debug sink. Defaults to false.

logPath.description: Optional explicit log-file path. Defaults to agenr-debug.jsonl inside the OpenClaw state directory.

eventLevel.description: Event detail level. Detailed enables bounded top-K candidate breakdowns for recall and before-turn events. Defaults to basic.

perSessionFiles.description: Split one JSONL file per OpenClaw session id. Defaults to false.

maxTopCandidates.description: Cap for top-K candidate breakdowns included in detailed events. Defaults to 10.

memoryPolicy.description: Optional runtime overrides for claim-aware read behavior exposed by the OpenClaw adapter.

sessionStart.description: Optional session-start overrides for prompt-time memory injection behavior.

enabled.description: Enable or disable all session-start memory injection. Defaults to true.

coreMemory.description: Enable or disable always-on Core Memory injection at session start. Defaults to true.

relevantDurableMemory.description: Enable or disable artifact-grounded Relevant Durable Memory injection at session start. Defaults to true.

beforeTurn.description: Optional before-turn overrides for proactive prompt-time memory injection behavior.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the proactive before-turn memory patch. Defaults to true.

procedureSuggestion.description: Enable or disable proactive high-confidence procedure suggestion inside the before-turn patch. Defaults to true.

maxDurableEntries.description: Normal durable-item cap for before-turn recall. Defaults to 1 and only expands when all surfaced items are very high confidence.

recallThreshold.description: Durable-recall score threshold required before an entry can surface during before-turn recall. Defaults to 0.6.

highConfidenceRecallThreshold.description: Durable-recall score threshold required before before-turn recall can expand beyond the normal durable-item cap. Defaults to 0.85.

procedureThreshold.description: Procedure-recall score threshold required before a proactive procedure can surface. Defaults to 0.72.

slotPolicies.description: Claim-slot policy overrides keyed by canonical claim-key attribute head.

attributeHeads.description: Map canonical attribute heads such as `integration` or `preference` to `exclusive` or `multivalued` read-time slot behavior.
